name: EZ Grader
tagline: EZ Grader is a dedicated digital solution designed to streamline the grading process for educators across all levels
description: EZ Grader is a dedicated digital solution designed to streamline the grading process for educators across all levels. By automating the calculation of percentages and scores, the platform removes the burden of manual arithmetic, allowing teachers to focus more on student development and less on repetitive administrative tasks. The tool is built to handle various assessment formats, ensuring that whether you are evaluating a short quiz or a comprehensive final exam, the results remain consistent
